headline: World Cup and America250 Usher in Expanded Surveillance Tech Across US Cities
reasoning: This topic is highly relevant to technology, focusing on the deployment of advanced surveillance systems like counter-drone tech, biometric cameras, and expanded CCTV networks. It's newsworthy due to the scale of implementation for major events and the significant implications for privacy, offering substantial value to tech-literate readers concerned about the intersection of technology and civil liberties.
summary: US cities hosting the World Cup and other major events like America250 are significantly increasing their surveillance capabilities, deploying counter-drone technology, biometric-enabled cameras, and expanded CCTV systems, raising privacy concerns among advocates.

source_articles.title: While you’re watching the World Cup, the feds may be watching you
